maya: quick heads-up: ruby quickstart stream drops with 401 after short-lived token rotation. repro in a minute.

maya: logs: 
```
[info] stream open
[auth] rotated token
[error] stream recv 401 unauthorized
```

lee: sync paths respect token refresh right?

maya: yes, only streaming path.

chris: likely we bake the header at connect and never re-read token on reconnect. go client pulls token each dial.

maya: snippet: `socket.write("GET /stream
Authorization: Bearer #{@init_token}

")`

chris: patch: use current_token() when assembling headers and add small jittered backoff (3 attempts). I'll open PR.

ci-bot: PR #623 opened by chris: fix/rb-stream-refresh-token (checks: lint, unit).

ci-bot: unit passed. integration pending flaky net test.

chris: swapped to fake socket in test to avoid flaky runner, re-run.

ci-bot: integration passed.

maya: verified locally, stream survives rotation now. added README note about ephemeral tokens for streams.

lee: please cherry-pick to v0.7.x and add changelog line.

maya: tagging @qa to add regression. closing after QA confirms. :thumbsup:
